judgment: Casting again, back to the source:
begin greatly, hold firm long — no harm.
Those who are unrestful are coming even now,
image: Water on the earth: Drawing Close.
So the early kings set up the many states
and kept close to the lords.
lines: If he draws close in trust: no harm.
His trust fills the jar full,
and in the end something else comes.
The king drives the hunt from three sides
and lets the game in front go.
The townsfolk are not warned: good.
He draws close, but with no head to it.

notes.name_en: 比 is side-by-side closeness/allegiance; 'Drawing Close', not Wilhelm's 'Holding Together'.
notes.judgment: 原筮 'casting again to the origin'; 後夫 the man who comes behind, 'latecomer'.
notes.L5: 三驅 the three-sided drive leaving one side open; 失前禽 the game ahead let go.
